scope: 阿联酋联邦层面的通用广告与消费者保护、促销许可、阿拉伯语义务、商品说明与标签、标准符合性与通信设备型号批准、电商信息披露、隐私告知；品类聚焦小家电、家居用品与 3C 数码。自由区（DIFC/ADGM）数据保护制度与各酋长国地方执法差异只标注，不逐区建库。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在“法条原文 + 页面原文”同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判“需要证明”；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 禁止以含虚假数据的方式描述商品或服务，也禁止以误导方式为其做广告；是否误导按整体印象与语境判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面快照（桌面/移动）、文案与图片原文、可核事实（规格书/检测报告）、同类表述的历史版本、投放渠道与时间。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 17 条按第 29 条：最高 2 年监禁，并处或单处 AED 10,000–2,000,000；再犯加倍。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The advertiser, provider and commercial agent are prohibited from describing the commodity or service in a manner containing false data or from advertising it in a misleading way.
rules.notes: 上位兜底条款。不凭词表单独下结论，必须落到具体句子的可核事实。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 商品或服务的描述、广告或要约，只要含有可能直接或间接造成不真实或误导印象的陈述，即构成欺骗性描述；条文列举七类要素（性质、特征、原产地、合同条款、奖项证书、商标标识、预期使用效果）。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面全文与版式、图片/视频、所称事实的支撑材料、同类页面历史版本。
rules.penalty_or_note: 欺骗性描述按《消费者保护法》第 17 条与第 29 条处理（最高 2 年监禁及 AED 10,000–2,000,000）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: A description, advertisement, or offer of a good or service, as case may be, shall be considered deceptive if it includes a misleading statement that may lead, directly or indirectly, to creating an unreal or misleading impression on the consumer, and in particular if it deals with one or more of the following elements:
rules.notes: 判断核心是“是否造成不真实或误导印象”，不是单个词。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 奖项、证书、质量标志、商标标识，以及“预期使用效果”类陈述，属于欺骗性描述的法定要素；只能要求商家提供证书/测试/授权依据，不能凭页面判断真伪。
rules.evidence_needed: 证书原件与编号、发证机构与认可范围、覆盖型号、有效期；商标注册与品牌授权；测试报告（方法、样本、日期）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同第 8 条；证书类陈述若无依据，可能同时落入第 17 条误导广告。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 4. Contract terms and procedures, including after-sales service, warranty, price, and type of payment; 5. Prizes, certificates or quality marks; 6. Trademarks, data, or logos; or 7. The characteristics of the good or service and the expected results from use thereof.
rules.notes: “CE”在阿联酋不是准入标志；页面出现 CE 不能当作已满足阿联酋要求，也不能当作违规。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 商品与服务的价格广告不得误导；比较价、折扣额与“原价”需要有真实、近期的成交基础。
rules.evidence_needed: 价格历史（含促销排期）、成交订单样本、划线价/“原价”的后台字段定义、同款在其他阿联酋渠道的售价。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 8 条第 1–3 款按第 29 条：最高 2 年监禁及 AED 10,000–2,000,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Advertising the prices of commodities and services offered by the provider must not be misleading.
rules.notes: 只处理金额与比较基准；“save time/energy”之类非价格表述不适用本条。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 开展促销、全面降价或任何形式的促销广告之前，须先取得主管机关的许可。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销许可/备案编号与有效期、促销活动规则、适用门店与线上渠道、活动起止日期。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 18 条按第 30 条：最高 6 个月监禁，并处或单处 AED 3,000–200,000；再犯加倍。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The provider is prohibited from promoting the commodities or services or from making general discounts to the prices or from advertising them in any way, until they obtain a prior license from the competent authority.
rules.notes: 阿联酋对“打折/促销”实行事前许可，这是与多数市场差异最大的一条；页面出现促销机制即应询问许可。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 以任何方式进行折扣或促销，须先取得主管机关许可；若折扣生效日在消费者购买后一周内，须告知消费者，否则消费者可在购买后 30 天内索回差价。
rules.evidence_needed: 折扣/促销许可、活动规则与生效日、告知方式（页面/短信/发票）、差价退还流程。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 31 条按第 30 条（第 18 条项下）处理：最高 6 个月监禁及 AED 3,000–200,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 1. The provider shall, upon making and announcing discounts in any means, obtain a prior licence from the competent authority in accordance with the procedures followed therein;
rules.notes: 与第 18 条并行：法律要求许可，条例细化了折扣告知与差价返还。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 与消费者相关的数据、广告与合同必须使用阿拉伯语；可以在阿拉伯语之外并列其他语言。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面/广告/合同的阿拉伯语版本截图、语言切换入口、阿语与英语内容是否一致。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 26 条按第 30 条：最高 6 个月监禁，并处或单处 AED 3,000–200,000；再犯加倍。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The data, advertising and contracts related to the consumer must be in Arabic, and it shall be permitted to use other languages alongside Arabic.
rules.notes: 纯英文页面（含只做英文广告）在阿联酋属于结构性缺口；应写“页面未见阿语版本，需核实”，而不是推断商家未提供。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 在阿联酋注册的电商提供者须向消费者与主管机关披露名称、法律形式、地址、发证机关，并就商品/服务、规格、合同条款、支付与保修提供充分的阿拉伯语信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 店铺“关于我们/联系方式”页、营业执照与发证机关、阿语商品信息、保修与支付条款。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 25 条不在第 29/30 条的列举清单内；实务中常与第 26 条（阿语）及电商法一并处理。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The e-commerce providers registered within the State shall be required to provide the consumers and competent authorities in the State with their names, legal statuses, addresses, licensing authorities and sufficient information in Arabic on the provided commodity or service, and its specifications, terms of contracting, payment and warranty; as prescribed by the Executive Regulation of this Law.
rules.notes: 适用前提是“在阿联酋注册”的电商提供者；跨境直邮主体的管辖需另行判断。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 商品上架销售时，须在其上清晰标注价格。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品页价格展示截图、变体（颜色/容量）价格是否齐全、是否需加入购物车才显示价格。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 8 条第 1–3 款按第 29 条：最高 2 年监禁及 AED 10,000–2,000,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Upon offering the commodity for sale, the provider shall be required to clearly write the price thereon.
rules.notes: “联系客服询价”“加入购物车后显示价格”是典型缺口。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 价格须以清晰可读方式公告（标在商品上、价签上或服务场所）；须明示是否接受折扣卡及折扣额；使用信用卡付款不得加收额外金额。
rules.evidence_needed: 价签/页面价格区块、结算页费用明细、支付方式与手续费规则。
rules.penalty_or_note: 条例未单列罚则，回到《消费者保护法》第 8 条与第 29 条。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 3. Not to add any additional amounts to the value of the goods in the event of using credit cards to purchase goods and services.
rules.notes: “信用卡加收 2%”在阿联酋属明文禁止。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 禁止在与消费者的合同中加入损害消费者的条款；排除提供方法定义务的条款无效。
rules.evidence_needed: 条款与条件全文、退换与保修条款、免责声明位置与显著性。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 21 条按第 29 条：最高 2 年监禁及 AED 10,000–2,000,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Every term in a contract, invoice or otherwise shall be deemed void if it would exempt the provider from any of the obligations provided in this Law.
rules.notes: “条款无效”不等于“页面存在应处罚情形”，报告只写条款可能被认定无效、需律师复核。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 不得以口头或任何媒介宣传商品保修，而不向消费者提供证明该保修的书面文件。
rules.evidence_needed: 保修卡/保修条款文件、保修范围与除外责任、提供方式（随箱/电子）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 条例未单列罚则，回到《消费者保护法》第 10 条与第 29 条。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The provider shall not advertise verbally or by any means of media about the warranty of the good without giving the consumer the document evidencing such warranty.
rules.notes: 页面写“1 年保修”本身不是问题；问题在是否随货提供保修文件。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.evidence_needed: —（罚则条目，用于报告的量刑区间引用）
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：2 年监禁 / AED 2,000,000；再犯加倍。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Whoever violates any of the provisions of Articles (7), (10), (11), (12), (15), (16), (17) and (21) and the provisions of Clauses One, Two and Three of Article (8) of this Law, shall be imprisoned for no longer than two years and fined no less than 10,000 (ten thousand) Dirhams and no more than 2,000,000 (two million) Dirhams, or by one of these penalties.
rules.notes: 只写“上限”，不写“必然处罚”。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 违反第 18、19、20、26 条及第 8 条第 4 款的刑事罚则：最高 6 个月监禁，并处或单处 AED 3,000–200,000；再犯加倍。
rules.evidence_needed: —（罚则条目）
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：6 个月监禁 / AED 200,000；再犯加倍。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Whoever violates any of the provisions of Articles (18), (19), (20) and (26) and the provisions of Clause Four of Article (8) of this Law, shall be imprisoned for no longer than six months and fined no less than 3,000 (three thousand) Dirhams and no more than 200,000 (two hundred thousand) Dirhams, or by one of these penalties.
rules.notes: 促销许可（第 18 条）、标准符合性（第 20 条）与阿语义务（第 26 条）都落在这一档。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (55) of 2023 Concerning Media Regulation 媒体监管法（2023 年第 55 号联邦法令）
rules.requirement: 所有广告主必须在全部广告材料中以明确、清晰的方式标明其为广告材料（含测评、软文、达人内容）。
rules.evidence_needed: 内容标注截图（含话题标签/角标）、投放合同或委托关系、发布账号与时间。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反媒体内容标准按第 23 条：AED 1,000–1,000,000 行政罚款；再犯加倍，最高 AED 2,000,000；并可警告、停业至 6 个月、吊销许可。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: All advertisers must include in all advertising materials something that explicitly and clearly indicates that it is advertising material.
rules.notes: “#ad”“Paid partnership”等标注是否足够“清晰”，属语境判断，需人工复核。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (55) of 2023 Concerning Media Regulation 媒体监管法（2023 年第 55 号联邦法令）
claim_pattern: they don't want you to know
rules.requirement: 不得发布违反媒体内容标准的宣传或广告，也不得直接或间接损害公共利益；内容标准包括不得散布谣言与误导性新闻（第 17 条第 15 项）、不得发布虚假新闻（第 13 项）。
rules.evidence_needed: 广告原文与素材、发布渠道、内容标准的逐项对照、第三方事实核查材料。
rules.penalty_or_note: 按第 23 条行政处罚（AED 1,000–1,000,000，再犯加倍）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It is not permissible to publish any propaganda or advertisement that violates the media content standards stipulated in this Law by Decree or that would harm the public interest therein directly or indirectly.
rules.notes: 与《消费者保护法》并行适用；媒体法偏内容与公共秩序，消费者保护法偏交易与商品描述。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (55) of 2023 Concerning Media Regulation 媒体监管法（2023 年第 55 号联邦法令）
rules.requirement: 媒体法行政罚款区间：不低于 AED 1,000、不超过 AED 1,000,000；再犯加倍且不超过 AED 2,000,000。
rules.evidence_needed: —（罚则条目）
rules.verbatim_excerpt: An administrative fine not be less than one thousand (1,000) AED and not exceeding one million (1,000,000) AED. The administrative fine shall be doubled when the violation is repeated, provided that it shall not exceed two million (2,000,000) AED.
rules.notes: 媒体法罚则为行政处罚，与消费者保护法的刑事罚则路径不同。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 商品的特性（含原产地、生产方式、生产日期、使用条件、重量、尺寸、容量、标准等）与原产国、出口国、生产主体，属于欺骗性描述的法定要素；原产地陈述需要可核依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 原产地证明/产地证、生产工厂与工序记录、供应链单据、设计/研发地的证明材料。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同第 8 条；虚假原产地可能同时落入第 17 条与商业欺诈相关立法。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 3. The country of origin, the country of export, or the entity producing the good;
rules.notes: “Designed in Italy / Made in China”这类组合表述要区分“设计地”与“原产地”，不能互相替代。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 商品或服务的特性与“预期使用效果”是欺骗性描述的法定要素；性能、效率、杀菌、健康类声称需要可核实的测试依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 测试报告（标准、方法、样本量、日期、实验室资质）、对照基准说明、宣称数值的适用范围。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同第 8 条；无法提供依据时不得在报告中判断真假，只能标“待证实”。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 7. The characteristics of the good or service and the expected results from use thereof.
rules.notes: “99.9%”类数字必须核对测试标准与适用对象（空气/水/表面）。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 商品包装或展示须清晰、可读地载明法定与标准要求的基本信息，至少包括：名称/种类/成分/数量、原产国（“Made in”+国名）、出口国（如有）、生产商或进口商名称与商业地址或商标、生产日期与保质期、贸易/储存/使用方法、错误使用的危险警告、可能暴露风险的消费者类别与年龄（儿童、残障、老人）。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装正反面与侧面实拍、标签稿、说明书、阿语与英语版本、进口商信息。
rules.penalty_or_note: 条例未单列罚则，回到《消费者保护法》第 7 条与第 29 条（最高 2 年监禁及 AED 10,000–2,000,000）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The provider shall clearly and legibly display the essential information specified by laws, regulations, technical standards, and approved specifications regarding the packaging or presentation of the product. Such data shall be according to the nature of the product and it shall include, but is not limited to, the following details:
rules.notes: 这是阿联酋标签的“母条款”；具体品类还要叠加对应的 UAE.S/GSO 标准。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 须以清晰、易读字体警告错误使用商品可能导致的危险。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装/说明书上的警告语（阿语+英语）、字号与对比度、儿童可及性风险说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 回到《消费者保护法》第 7 条第 2 款与第 29 条。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 7. Warning of the dangers that may result from the wrong use of the good, which shall be in a clear and easy-to-read font;
rules.notes: 警告语缺失属于高风险项，但只能写“页面/可见包装未展示”，需向商家索取实物标签。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 上架销售时须在商品封面/包装或清晰可读位置加贴标签，并按国家标准说明安装与使用方法；涉及风险的商品须清楚警告。
rules.evidence_needed: 标签实拍、安装/使用说明、标准符合性声明、风险警告内容。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 7 条按第 29 条：最高 2 年监禁及 AED 10,000–2,000,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Upon offering the commodity for sale, the provider shall be required to place the labelling on its cover or package, or in a clear and legible place, and to clarify how to install and use it, in accordance with the existing legislation in the State with regard to the standard specifications.
rules.notes: 法律层要求 + 条例层细化（AE-LBL-01/02），接入时按同一 finding 合并。

rules.law_name: Cabinet Resolution No. (66) of 2023 Concerning the Executive Regulations of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法实施条例（2023 年第 66 号内阁决议）
rules.requirement: 须随商品提供使用与安装说明；安装/使用方法须清晰载于包装或外包装；须明确箱内物品清单，并说明为使用主体商品还需另行购买的配件。
rules.evidence_needed: 说明书、包装内清单、安装图示、另行购买配件的提示位置。
rules.penalty_or_note: 回到《消费者保护法》第 7 条与第 29 条。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It is required to clearly and explicitly state the contents of the box containing the goods, as well as identifying any complementary item that shall be purchased in order to avail of the basic good.
rules.notes: “电池不含/需另购”未标注是常见缺口。

rules.law_name: Federal Law No. (15) of 2020 Concerning Consumer Protection 消费者保护法（2020 年第 15 号联邦法）
rules.requirement: 提供者须确保商品或服务符合标准规范（UAE.S / GSO 及采纳的 IEC 标准）以及与健康、安全相关的条件与现行立法。
rules.evidence_needed: 符合性证书（ECAS/COC）编号与覆盖型号、测试报告（IEC 60335 系列等）、G-Mark（如适用）、进口商与责任主体。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反第 20 条按第 30 条：最高 6 个月监禁及 AED 3,000–200,000。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The provider shall be required to ensure the conformity of the commodity or service to the standard specifications, terms and controls related to health and safety and the relevant existing legislation in the State.
rules.notes: ECAS 注册与 G-Mark 的具体流程属执行层，本版未逐 SKU 建库（见 README Open Questions）。

rules.law_name: TDRA — Register and Approve Telecommunication Equipment (service card) TDRA 通信设备注册与型号批准服务说明
rules.requirement: 电信设备在投放阿联酋市场销售前，须在 TDRA 型号批准系统中注册并获得批准；设备按风险分 Level 1–3，Level 3 需技术检验。
rules.evidence_needed: TDRA 设备注册证书编号与型号、Level 分类、进口商/供应商注册状态、无线模块规格。
rules.penalty_or_note: 服务页未列罚则；未注册设备的销售限制由 TDRA 依通信立法执行。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Registering and approving telecommunications devices before they are put up for sale in the country's markets by providing the required information and documents in the type approval system.
rules.notes: 页面通常不展示 TDRA 注册号；只能写“页面未展示，需向商家核实”。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (14) of 2023 Concerning the Modern Technology-Based Trade 现代技术贸易法（2023 年第 14 号联邦法令，电商法）
rules.requirement: 须在网站/应用上公开商品与服务价格、物流与数字支付费用、交易各阶段条款；无数字合同时须公开条款与条件。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品页与结算页截图（含税费、运费）、条款与条件页面、价格构成说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚则由 2025 年第 200 号内阁决议规定（本版未取得原文，见 Open Questions）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Determining the terms, conditions and details of the multiple stages regarding the sale of goods and services through Modern Technology, including specifying the price of goods and services, fees and prices for logistics services and digital payment services, in addition to making the same publicly available on the website, application or other Modern Technology for the digital trader and making the digital contract or terms and conditions available in such regard if there is no digital contract, provided that the purchase of goods and services shall be deemed acceptance by the consumer of the digital contract or these terms and conditions.
rules.notes: 只写“页面未公开某项费用”，不推断商家故意隐藏。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (14) of 2023 Concerning the Modern Technology-Based Trade 现代技术贸易法（2023 年第 14 号联邦法令，电商法）
rules.requirement: 禁止以误导方式交易，或提供不能真实描述商品/服务的数据；“原装/正品/全新/官方店”等陈述须有可核依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 品牌授权书、进货链路单据、序列号规则、官方店授权页面、拆封/翻新状态说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚则见 2025 年第 200 号内阁决议（未取得原文）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Refraining from dealing in a misleading manner or provide incorrect data that does not give the true description of the good or service.
rules.notes: 平台店铺类型（官方/旗舰/第三方）不等于品牌授权，需看授权文件。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (14) of 2023 Concerning the Modern Technology-Based Trade 现代技术贸易法（2023 年第 14 号联邦法令，电商法）
rules.requirement: 消费者有权选择接收或拒绝接收促销/营销信息，渠道包括通信、电子邮件与社交媒体平台。
rules.evidence_needed: 订阅勾选与默认状态、退订入口、营销授权记录、渠道清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚则见 2025 年第 200 号内阁决议（未取得原文）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The option to receive or refuse to receive promotional or marketing campaigns, whether through communications, emails or social media platforms.
rules.notes: 默认勾选、退订入口隐藏是典型缺口。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (14) of 2023 Concerning the Modern Technology-Based Trade 现代技术贸易法（2023 年第 14 号联邦法令，电商法）
rules.requirement: 须向公众公开数字交易者的执照（发证机关）、地址、联系电话、实际营业地址与网站信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 页脚/关于我们/联系方式页截图、营业执照与编号、实际地址与客服电话。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚则见 2025 年第 200 号内阁决议（未取得原文）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Make the data available to the public regarding the digital trader license from the competent authority, its address, contact numbers, details of its physical address and its website.
rules.notes: 仅留邮箱或在线表单、无实体地址，属披露缺口。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (45) of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data 个人数据保护法（2021 年第 45 号联邦法令）
rules.requirement: 控制者在开始处理个人数据之前，必须向数据主体提供处理目的、数据共享的对象行业/机构（境内外）以及跨境传输的保护措施。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私政策全文与生效日、收集点告知（注册/结算/订阅）、共享对象清单、跨境传输条款。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 26 条授权内阁决议设定行政处罚；本版未取得罚则附表（见 Open Questions）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In all cases, the Controller shall, before starting the processing, provide the Data Subject with the information stipulated in paragraphs (b), (d) and (g) of Paragraph (1) of this Article.
rules.notes: (b)=处理目的、(d)=共享对象、(g)=跨境传输保护措施；仅有一句“我们重视您的隐私”不满足。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (45) of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data 个人数据保护法（2021 年第 45 号联邦法令）
rules.requirement: 同意须以清晰、简单、无歧义且易于获取的方式作出（书面或电子），并须包含数据主体可轻易撤回同意的权利。
rules.evidence_needed: 同意界面截图（默认状态、勾选框）、同意记录、撤回同意的路径、政策中的撤回说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 26 条授权内阁决议设定行政处罚（未取得附表）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: b. The Consent shall be prepared in a clear, simple, unambiguous and easily accessible manner, whether in writing or electronically. c. The Consent shall include the Data Subject's right to withdraw it easily.
rules.notes: “继续浏览即视为同意”与“预勾选”都难以满足“清晰、无歧义”；需人工看界面。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (45) of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data 个人数据保护法（2021 年第 45 号联邦法令）
rules.requirement: 未经数据主体同意，禁止处理其个人数据；条文列有 11 项例外（公共利益、合同履行、法定义务等）。
rules.evidence_needed: 数据收集清单、同意记录、所依赖的例外情形与法律依据、处理目的说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 第 26 条授权内阁决议设定行政处罚（未取得附表）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It is prohibited to process Personal Data without the consent of its owner.
rules.notes: 先问“依据哪一项例外”，再谈页面告知是否充分。

rules.law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. (14) of 2023 Concerning the Modern Technology-Based Trade 现代技术贸易法（2023 年第 14 号联邦法令，电商法）
rules.requirement: 消费者信息与数据不得在未经其同意的情况下交易或提供；数据保护适用阿联酋现行数据保护立法。
rules.evidence_needed: 数据共享清单与合同、同意记录、第三方 SDK/像素清单、数据买卖条款。
rules.penalty_or_note: 罚则见 2025 年第 200 号内阁决议（未取得原文）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The criteria and requirements regarding the protection and security of consumer information and data, in addition, the same may not be traded or made available without his consent.
rules.notes: 与 PDPL 并行；本条更直接指向“消费者数据交易”。
